description: The simulation-affecting participant input-hold policy. Every checked-in world authors the section explicitly; measured tick counts arrive on tick-stamped intent submissions and never read a clock here.

ceilingTicks.description: The maximum applied hold, in simulation ticks.

lowerAfterTicks.description: How many simulation ticks a lower target must remain unchanged before descent.

defaultTicks.description: The authored hold floor for participants without an override.

equalizeByDefault.description: Whether participants without an override share the maximum.

participants.description: Participant-specific floor and distribution overrides, keyed by body index.

items.description: One participant-specific input-hold override. An omitted body uses the section defaults.

ticks.description: The authored hold floor, in simulation ticks.

equalized.description: Whether this participant contributes to and receives the shared maximum.
